Oversight Board Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente Oversight Board Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
FEBRUARY 28, 2013
3:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
MEMBERS: KLINAKIS, MATSUMOTO, BACA, SCROGGINS, TORRES
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
OATH OF OFFICE
OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO BOARD MEMBER RAUL PURIFICACIÓN
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - None.
If you wish to address the Oversight Board on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the Secretary no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS OVERSIGHT BOARD MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JANUARY 10, 2013
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the Oversight Board waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Oversight Board Meeting of January 10, 2013.
01-10-13 Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE OVERSIGHT BOARD - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE OVERSIGHT BOARD - None.
D.
OVERSIGHT BOARD CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE OVERSIGHT BOARD
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY FOR FY 2013-2014
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the Board approve the attached Resolution adopting the Successor Agency's Administrative Budget for Fiscal Year 2013-2014.
E-1 Budget Report & Attachments
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE THIRD RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE ("ROPS") COVERING THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2013 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2013
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the Board approve the attached Resolution adopting the third Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule covering the period of July 1, 2013 through December 31, 2013.
E-2 ROPS Report & Attachments
ORAL COMMENTS FROM BOARD MEMBERS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
02-28-13-Oversight Board Minutes - signed
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
minutes_text:
Oversight Board Regular Meeting
MINUTES
LA PUENTE OVERSIGHT BOARD REGULAR MEETING
REGULAR MEETING OF
February 28, 2013
A Regular Meeting of the Oversight Board Regular Meeting of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on February 28, 2013, at 3:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - None.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS OVERSIGHT BOARD MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JANUARY 10, 2013
01-10-13 Minutes
Board Member Baca moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Oversight Board Meeting of January 10, 2013.; seconded by Chair Klinakis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Chair Klinakis, Vice Chair Matsumoto, Board Member Baca, Board Member Purificacion, Board Member Scroggins, Board Member Seder, and Board Member Torres. NOES: None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE OVERSIGHT BOARD - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE OVERSIGHT BOARD - None.
D.
OVERSIGHT BOARD CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE OVERSIGHT BOARD
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY FOR FY 2013-2014
E-1 Budget Report & Attachments
Board Member Scroggins moved to Resolution No. 13-10 adopting the Successor Agency's Administrative Budget for Fiscal Year 2013-2014.; seconded by Board Member Baca.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Chair Klinakis, Vice Chair Matsumoto, Board Member Baca, Board Member Purificacion, Board Member Scroggins, Board Member Seder, and Board Member Torres. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE THIRD RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE ("ROPS") COVERING THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2013 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2013
E-2 ROPS Report & Attachments
Board Member Scroggins moved to Resolution No. 13-11 adopting the third Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule covering the period of July 1, 2013 through December 31, 2013.; seconded by Board Member Baca.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Chair Klinakis, Vice Chair Matsumoto, Board Member Baca, Board Member Purificacion, Board Member Scroggins, Board Member Seder, and Board Member Torres. NOES: None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM BOARD MEMBERS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
02-28-13-Oversight Board Minutes - signed
Approved this
_________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC
City Clerk/Secretary
_________________________________
Charlie Klinakis
Mayor/Chair
